items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: one of the men that killed Clyde Barrow in that big dusty raid(?) we had down here back then

ctx.x: Yeah. Three Black bands. And we was the populest (sic) band that was in town. Later on, I found that the lady that was running the other club where we had been playing didn't have no band up... She had a band up there to play for her, and the band was going out there working at this place. So she got in... Anyway, she sent the lawyers out there. The sheriff come out there, him and another man, and he said he was a lawyer, and then one of the men that killed Clyde Barrow in that big dusty raid(?) we had down here…
Was that because they didn't like Black and White dancers in the same room?
